svg.title: LabShare master workflow
svg.desc: Swimlane of a lab resource moving from owner listing through student discovery, eligibility, fairness checks, owner approval or waitlist, check-in, return, condition verification and incident review, all recorded in an append-only audit log.
svg.text: Every step above writes who · what · when · why. Nobody can edit or delete it.
Visible to student · owner · manager · admin
AI only advises. Approvals, penalties and verifications stay with a person.
